extension.description: Shows separate public and private KingBlap Kodi build choices. Public builds omit saved account profile data; private builds require an access code and may restore saved service credentials. The Wizard enables packaged add-ons, sets Gismeteo for Thomasville, removes the OnePlay repository, and applies Xonfluence 6.0.7.
extension.disclaimer: Public builds do not include saved add-on account profile data from the backup. Private builds may include service credentials saved in add-on profile data and require a shared access code. Review the selected build before installing it.
